none: PAS CAM-274513: Roman Coin : A copper-alloy radiate probably of Tacitus
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy radiate probably of Tacitus. AD275-276, (Reece period 14). Reverse legend reads [FELICIT?]AS (TEMP). Reverse shows ?Felicitas standing left. Mint is probably/possibly Gaul. See RIC V, pt.I, p.328, c.f.18-19. Obverse shows Radiate bust right. Obverse legend reads [...]S AVG. Condition is poor, die axis is 12 o'clock, weight is 2.63g, diameter is 21.2mm
